title: Signal Engine
teaser: Internal analytics tooling for emerging safety risks and recall detection.
headline: A compact internal product that turned murky safety signals into reviewable decisions.
challenge: WSP needed a legible way to spot emerging safety risks and possible recalls without forcing teams through a slow reporting loop.
outcome: Ali built the interface and workflow logic around TypeScript, Codex, and Python-based analysis so teams could move from noise to action faster while supporting renewal conversations.
bullets: Built an internal analytics tool with TypeScript and Codex to analyze emerging safety risks with 86% accuracy.
Developed a machine learning workflow in Python that identified potential recalls with 79% success.
The recall workflow supported $600k in renewals by making operational insight more defensible.
